title: AI Led Forward Deployed Engineer | Design & Digital Products
description:
**you are:**

*as an ai led fde , you embed with design \& product teams to originate, design, and ship ai\-powered digital products and experiences into production. you will build on top of enterprise data and technology foundations to create ai\-powered products that face customers, employees, and business users, driving revenue, engagement, and better decisions*

 ***the work:***

* identify where ai creates measurable business value before a brief exists. originate use cases, prioritize by impact, and shape the engagement.
* differentiate through a product\-led approach. pair ai \& data depth with product strategy and product thinking, so the work ladders to a real product and its outcomes, not a proof of concept.
* bring fluency in the design\-to\-product pipeline. move from insight and concept through design, prototype, and production the way design \& digital products builds, connecting strategy directly to what ships.
* design and build ai systems end to end: rag architecture, agentic orchestration, prompt \& context engineering, evals \& guardrails, tool\-use patterns, and mcp integration.
* select the right model and approach: frontier\-model selection, and when to apply fine\-tuning (lora / peft) vs. prompt engineering vs. rag, exercising judgment over execution across cost, latency, accuracy, and compliance tradeoffs.
* activate ai within the client's existing enterprise data platforms. connect ai products to where the data lives using data\-gravity patterns rather than re\-architecting infrastructure.
* build ai\-powered digital products and experiences full\-stack, with production accountability. ship working code, not recommendations.
* deploy responsibly to production: mlops, model serving, security, and cost / latency discipline at product level, with effective monitoring.
* codify best\-practice delivery patterns and feed field learnings back into the offering to make delivery repeatable.

  

***basic required qualifications:***

* minimum 3 years of ai \& data experience, including solutioning, designing, or delivering ai \& data projects, with hands\-on work shipping genai features (rag, agentic workflows, evals and guardrails), not strategy decks alone.
* minimum 3 years of high\-value consulting experience, including large\-scale delivery with minimal oversight and proven ability to lead workstreams and meet deadlines, or relevant industry / functional experience.

**prefered qualificaitions:**

* hands\-on delivery experience on at least one enterprise ai platform in production: aws bedrock, google vertex ai, azure ai foundry, or databricks mosaic ai.
* working fluency with genai frameworks and patterns: langchain or llamaindex, agentic orchestration (crewai / autogen), mcp, prompt and context engineering, and model selection across frontier and open\-weight models (claude, gemini, gpt, llama, mistral).
* model judgment: knows when to apply fine\-tuning (lora / peft) vs. prompt engineering vs. rag, and can reason about cost, latency, accuracy, and compliance tradeoffs.
* product engineering ability: full\-stack build of ai\-powered digital products, ships working code, and can activate ai against existing enterprise data using data\-gravity patterns rather than re\-architecting infrastructure.
* product\-led mindset: connects ai \& data work to product strategy and the design\-to\-product pipeline, and can originate use cases and shape an engagement before a brief exists.
* experience managing senior stakeholders.
* strong program management and verbal and written communication skills.
* driven and entrepreneurial: ability to originate and shape new deals and lead go\-to\-market activities.
* excellent leadership and people skills: proven ability to build effective teams, foster collaboration and inclusion, and build strong relationships with stakeholders / clients.

title: Senior - Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**who we are**

at kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. so why work at kyndryl? we are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.


**the role**

your role
  

as a forward deployed engineer (fde), you own end to end delivery for complex ai engagements. you translate business challenges into technical solutions, lead solution design and deployment, and operate as a trusted technical partner to customers. you are accountable not just for what gets built, but for whether it works\-technically, operationally, and for the people who rely on it.
  

  

you operate with significant autonomy, bring deep expertise in at least one technical domain, and confidently bridge engineering rigor with business value. you use ai assisted development tools across the full delivery lifecycle to accelerate learning, improve quality, and deliver measurable impact.
  

  

what you will do
  

* customer engagement \& solution integrity: partner with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into high‑quality, fit‑for‑purpose technical solutions, prioritising the right outcome over the fastest one
* rapid prototyping: build and iterate custom ai solutions tailored to customer needs, leveraging agentic ai frameworks
* ownership, deployment \& partnership: own delivery end to end, from scoping to production. work as part of the customer team to engineer and deploy production‑ready solutions that drive adoption and measurable business outcomes.
* optimization: troubleshoot and enhance system performance, scalability, and reliability
* field intelligence: systematically capture deployment learnings, document best practices, and proactively share insights to inform enhancements to kyndryl’s core platforms and frameworks
* continuous learning: adapt quickly to emerging technologies and evolving customer requirements by engaging in ongoing professional development
* platform contribution: actively contribute to the evolution of kyndryl’s ai platforms through feedback, code contributions, and collaboration with product teams
kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against covid\-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective covid\-19 vaccination policies. those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.


**who you are**

required skills and experience
  

  

* programming proficiency: demonstrable expertise in python, (or another modern language such as c\#, node.js or typescript); experience working with ai/ml frameworks like tensorflow or pytorch is a plus
* software engineering: solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (git \& github), and data engineering tools such as pandas and spark
* cloud \& distributed systems: experience with cloud ai platforms (aws, azure, google ai) and distributed computing architectures

  

preferred skills and experience
  

  

* open\-source ecosystems: familiarity with community\-driven ai tools and libraries, including hugging face and relevant repositories
* t\-shaped profile: deep technical expertise in one or two domains, with broad understanding across ai/ml, cloud, and consulting
* agentic ai systems: experience designing, building, or integrating multi\-agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., langgraph, semantic kernel, agent framework, autogen, crewai), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms
* retrieval\-augmented generation (rag) \& knowledge systems: practical knowledge of deploying rag architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into ai solutions
* performance \& security: knowledge of system\-level optimisation and security best practices for scalable ai systems
* business acumen: ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences
* flexibility: willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required
* education: degree\-level qualification in computer science, informatics, data science, engineering, or a closely related discipline \- or equivalent professional experience
**must be willing to work onsite west palm beach, fl**

**being you**

diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. but we’re not doing it single\-handily: our kyndryl inclusion networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. this dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. that’s the kyndryl way.


**what you can expect**

with state\-of\-the\-art resources and fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. kyndryl cares about your well\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including microsoft, google, amazon, skillsoft, and many more. through our company\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\-profit organizations. at kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

title: Desktop Software Engineer & Application Modernization
description:
**job overview**  
join our dynamic team as a desktop software engineer \& application modernization specialist, where you'll drive innovative solutions to enhance desktop applications and modernize legacy systems. this role offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of software engineering, leveraging cutting\-edge technologies to build scalable, efficient, and user\-centric applications. you will be instrumental in transforming existing systems into robust, cloud\-enabled platforms that meet evolving business needs. if you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and are passionate about creating impactful software solutions, this is the perfect role for you!

**duties**

* design, develop, and maintain desktop applications across various platforms, ensuring high performance and user experience excellence.
* lead application modernization initiatives by migrating legacy systems to modern architectures utilizing microservices, restful apis, and cloud infrastructure such as aws.
* collaborate with cross\-functional teams using agile software development methodologies to deliver iterative improvements and innovative features.
* develop scalable systems by applying system design principles, design patterns, and best practices in software engineering.
* implement front\-end development using javascript frameworks like react and express, coupled with back\-end services built on java, python, ruby on rails, or c\+\+.
* integrate apis and third\-party services to enhance application functionality while ensuring security through rbac (role\-based access control) and other security protocols.
* utilize version control tools such as github, svn, and git for code management; set up ci/cd pipelines for seamless deployment.
* optimize applications for scalability and performance in cloud environments like aws while maintaining robust sql databases such as mysql and system integration with rest apis.

**skills**

* strong expertise in it infrastructure management including cloud infrastructure (aws), linux environments, and network considerations.
* proficiency in programming languages including javascript, java, python, c\+\+, c, vba, and ruby on rails for diverse application development needs.
* deep understanding of software design principles, system design for system development, scalability strategies, and microservices architecture.
* experience with web development frameworks such as react and express for front\-end development; knowledge of restful api design is essential.
* familiarity with agile software development practices including scrum or kanban; experience with version control systems like github and svn.
* knowledge of database management systems such as mysql and sql server; ability to optimize queries for performance enhancement.
* understanding of security protocols including rbac; experience implementing secure apis using rest standards.
* exposure to quantum engineering concepts is a plus but not mandatory; a passion for continuous learning is highly valued.

this role offers an energetic environment where your technical expertise will directly impact our digital transformation efforts! we are committed to fostering growth through innovative projects that challenge your skills while supporting your professional development every step of the way.

pay: $30\.00 per hour

expected hours: 35\.0 per week

work location: in person
